goal: Resume interrupted reindexes from the last completed block file instead of starting over from scratch
Avoids discarding hours or days of indexing work when a node restarts or crashes during a reindex
reviewability: Author silent for 132 days, so review feedback may wait a long time for a response
agreement: Blocking objection: adds database complexity without evidence of meaningful restart benefits (maflcko)
Unaddressed objection: restart without -reindex already skips blocks and quickly resumes (mzumsande)
Concerns about slowing the reindex happy path were resolved by saving only on interrupt (maflcko, mzumsande)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because resuming reindex progress avoids repeating work across processed block files
Existing restart behavior already avoids re-processing blocks, making this an incremental improvement
